source_build: ACNH 1.0.0 local ExeFS main.elf and 523-layout RomFS catalog
matching_rule: Strip the exact suffix Page from the native page class string, then compare the result exactly with screen_catalog.json layout name.
limits: Name equality is only a candidate link. It does not prove the page loads or owns that BFLYT.
Layout native-string references may belong to unrelated code paths; they are included for follow-up only and do not prove a page-to-layout edge.
All page-to-layout links remain unproven until a direct native call/data edge or runtime trace connects the page to the layout request.

static_calltree_probe.method: Decoded direct AArch64 BL edges from constructor-installed page pointer-sequence entries and followed up to three direct-call levels; checked each candidate layout name against function string-reference entries.
static_calltree_probe.limit: This is a negative result for indexed direct-call paths only. It does not rule out indirect calls, names assembled dynamically, alias tables, or a resource request outside the page vtable call tree.
